title: My live location share
summary: While this account shares its live location: a bar at the top of the chat that shares, and a row at the top of the chat list, each with a stop button.

roomId.description: The chat that gets the positions.

shares.description: The running shares of the current account, from the app's live location service.

foregroundOnly.description: iOS: location access is 'when in use' only; the bar shows bipe_app_location_live_open_only.

stop.effect: Chat bar: Room.stopLiveLocationShare for this chat. Chat list row: stops every share of the account. The bar or row goes away.

openSettings.effect: iOS, foregroundOnly: opens the app's page in iPhone Settings.

notes: The chat bar sits above the timeline, under the call bar: bipe_app_location_live_sharing, bipe_app_location_live_until with endsAt, and the button bipe_app_location_live_stop.
The chat list row sits above the list on both tabs: bipe_app_location_live_sharing and bipe_app_location_live_stop. One row for all running shares.
Android: the ongoing notification of the foreground service is the same share; its stop action stops every share of the account.
